annotation_policy: Manual deterministic native source-pixel samples on directly visible static NBA court paint only. The score bug, people and other occlusions are skipped. No player, ball, body, generated appearance point or cross-camera pixel transfer is permitted.

regulation_geometry.coordinate_system: basket-local centimetres: +X from backboard face toward court, +Y across court, Z=0 floor

seed_only_correspondences.note: These four approximate lane corners initialize the nonlinear solver only; they are excluded from every residual and metric gate.

notes: Broadcast is a distinct physical sideline baseline. Mobile Broadcast, Other Broadcast and Play by Play are near-duplicate/crop-family feeds and are not counted as independent metric cameras. v44 deliberately tests the undistorted pinhole-floor hypothesis at the established two-pixel held-out standard.
